Senses.Explanation: A battle-tested accomplished hand joins repeated combat with demonstrated capability. Chan masters use the martial appraisal in public encounters, but the same label can precede praise, a direct invitation to enter, or a verdict that even the seasoned hand failed. Tianyin calls Zhaozhou battle-tested and says his attempt could not shake the hermit. Baochi addresses his assembly as long-tested accomplished hands. Shiguan applies the phrase to Huayan and then faults both sides of the encounter. Yushan calls the present assembly seasoned and invites them to meet the celebrated elder.
